words.definition: n. 病房；选区；受监护人 v. 避开，挡住

examples.en: Visiting hours in the children's ward are from 2 to 4.
examples.zh: 儿科病房探视时间为两点到四点。

examples.en: She warded off the blow with her arm.
examples.zh: 她抬臂挡开了那一击。

words.usage: hospital ward（医院病房）；ward off（避开，挡住：ward off evil/colds）高频；wardrobe 衣柜同根（ward 保管 + robe 袍）。
words.mnemonic: ward 看护之地 → 病房；看守 → 挡开

words.definition: n. 速记（法）；简略表达方式

examples.en: The secretary took the minutes in shorthand.
examples.zh: 秘书用速记法做会议记录。

examples.en: The term has become shorthand for economic decline.
examples.zh: 这个词已成为经济衰退的代名词。

words.usage: in shorthand（用速记记下）；比喻义「…的简称/代名词」：shorthand for（…的简略说法）高频。longhand（普通书写）反义。
words.mnemonic: short(短)+hand(写)→ 短写法 → 速记

words.definition: adj. 永久的，长期的

examples.en: She finally found a permanent job.
examples.zh: 她终于找到了一份长期工作。

examples.en: The exhibition has found a permanent home in the city.
examples.zh: 该展览在这座城市有了永久馆址。

words.usage: permanent job/resident/status（固定工作/永久居民/长期身份）高频；permanence n. 永久性；permanently adv.。per（贯穿）+ man（停留）。
words.mnemonic: per(全)+man(留)→ 一直留着 → 永久

words.definition: adj. 温柔的；嫩的；疼痛的 v./n. 投标

examples.en: The nurse was tender with the elderly patient.
examples.zh: 护士对老年病人十分温柔。

examples.en: The firm won the tender for the new bridge.
examples.zh: 该公司赢得了新桥工程的投标。

words.usage: 多义高频：①温柔（tender heart）②肉嫩（tender meat）③疼痛敏感（tender spot）④投标（win/submit a tender）⑤tender age 幼年。tenderly adv.。
words.mnemonic: tend(伸展)轻柔 → 温柔；嫩；投标

words.definition: adv. 从而，因此（由此手段）

examples.en: He signed the contract, thereby accepting all the terms.
examples.zh: 他签了合同，从而接受了全部条款。

examples.en: The tax cut increased spending, thereby stimulating the economy.
examples.zh: 减税增加了消费，从而刺激了经济。

words.usage: 正式书面，常置于分词前表结果：thereby doing sth（从而…）；与 therefore（因果连接词）之别：thereby 指通过该行为达成。
words.mnemonic: there+by → 由那一步 → 从而

words.definition: n. 架子，搁物架 v. 使痛苦，折磨

examples.en: Put the dishes back on the rack.
examples.zh: 把盘子放回架子上。

examples.en: She was racked with guilt after the quarrel.
examples.zh: 争吵后她被内疚折磨着。

words.usage: luggage roof rack（行李架）；torture rack；be racked with pain/guilt（受痛苦/内疚折磨）书面高频；习语 rack one's brains（绞尽脑汁）。与 wrack（废墟）常混，rack 通用。
collocations: rack one's brains 绞尽脑汁
racked with pain 备受折磨
words.mnemonic: 架（rack）起刑架 → 架；折磨

words.definition: n. 震惊；电击；休克 v. 使震惊

examples.en: The news of his death came as a great shock.
examples.zh: 他去世的消息令人大为震惊。

examples.en: She was shocked by the violence in the film.
examples.zh: 电影中的暴力让她震惊。

words.usage: culture shock（文化冲击）、electric shock（电击）、in shock（休克；震惊失神）高频；shocking adj. 令人震惊的（也表「太糟糕」口语）。
words.mnemonic: 一股电流般的打击 → 震惊；休克

words.definition: n. 参议员

examples.en: The senator promised to fight for tax reform.
examples.zh: 这位参议员承诺为税改而战。

examples.en: Two senators voted against the bill.
examples.zh: 两名参议员投票反对该法案。

words.usage: Senator Smith（史密斯参议员）头衔大写；senatorial adj. 参议员的；女性也用 senator。与 congressperson（众议员）区分。
collocations: senator from… 来自…的参议员
run for senator 竞选参议员
words.mnemonic: senate(参议院)+or → 参议员

words.definition: n. 半岛

examples.en: Korea is located on a peninsula in East Asia.
examples.zh: 朝鲜半岛位于东亚。

examples.en: They built a lighthouse on the rocky peninsula.
examples.zh: 他们在多岩石的半岛建了灯塔。

words.usage: pen（几乎）+ insula（岛）→ 类岛之陆 → 半岛；the Iberian Peninsula（伊比利亚半岛）、the Korean Peninsula（朝鲜半岛）高频；peninsular adj.。

confusables.note: penultimate 倒数第二，pen- 同头

collocations: the Korean Peninsula 朝鲜半岛
Iberian Peninsula 伊比利亚半岛
words.mnemonic: pen(几乎)+insula(岛)→ 半岛

words.definition: n. 学期（约半年）

examples.en: The new semester begins in September.
examples.zh: 新学期九月开始。

examples.en: She took five courses last semester.
examples.zh: 上学期她修了五门课。

words.usage: 美式学制常用 semester（两学期制），英式多用 term（三学期制）；last/next semester；semester break 学期假期。德语借词（semestris 半年）。
words.mnemonic: seme(半年)+ster → 半年制学期

words.definition: n. 保修单，保证书；（正当）理由

examples.en: The car is still under warranty.
examples.zh: 这辆车还在保修期内。

examples.en: There is no warranty that the plan will succeed.
examples.zh: 无法保证该计划一定成功。

words.usage: under warranty（在保修期内）高频；extended warranty（延长保修）；动词 warrant（保证；使有理由）→ unwarranted（无根据的）。与 guarantee 同义略别：warranty 偏书面保修。
words.mnemonic: warrant(保证)+y → 保修凭证

words.definition: n. 半径；（活动）半径范围

examples.en: The circle has a radius of five centimetres.
examples.zh: 这个圆的半径是五厘米。

examples.en: They searched within a ten-mile radius of the hotel.
examples.zh: 他们在酒店方圆十英里内展开搜索。

words.usage: 复数 radii/radiuses；within a… radius of（在以…为圆心的范围）高频；radiate v. 辐射、radioactive 放射的同根（rad 光线）。
collocations: within a… radius 在…半径内
radius of action 活动半径
words.mnemonic: radi(光线)射出的距离 → 半径

words.definition: n. 老兵；老手 adj. 资深的

examples.en: His grandfather is a war veteran.
examples.zh: 他祖父是位老兵。

examples.en: She is a veteran journalist of thirty years.
examples.zh: 她是拥有三十年经验的资深记者。

words.usage: war veteran（退伍老兵）；veteran politician/actor（政界元老/资深演员）高频形容词用法；Veterans Day 退伍军人节。词源 vet（老）。
words.mnemonic: vetus（老）→ 老兵 → 老手

words.definition: adj. 粗糙的，粗颗粒的；粗俗的

examples.en: The sweater was made of coarse wool.
examples.zh: 这件毛衣由粗羊毛织成。

examples.en: His coarse jokes offended several guests.
examples.zh: 他粗俗的笑话冒犯了几位客人。

words.usage: coarse salt/skin/language（粗盐/粗糙皮肤/粗话）高频；与 course（课程；一道菜）同音必辨！coarsely adv. 粗糙地；coarseness 粗糙。
words.mnemonic: course 走了岔路 → 粗糙；粗俗

words.definition: n. 部分；部门；（文章）节；截面

examples.en: The smoking section is at the back of the plane.
examples.zh: 吸烟区在飞机后部。

examples.en: Read section two before the next class.
examples.zh: 下节课前阅读第二节。

words.usage: sect（切）+ ion → 切开的部分；cross-section（横截面；典型样本）高频；sector（经济部门）与之辨析。同根：dissect 解剖、intersect 相交。
words.mnemonic: sect(切)+ion → 切出的部分

words.definition: n. 缝，接缝；矿层 v. 缝合

examples.en: The seam of the trousers came apart.
examples.zh: 裤子的接缝开裂了。

examples.en: The ship burst at the seams under the pressure.
examples.zh: 船体在压力下裂开。

words.usage: burst/seam at the seams（破裂；挤满）习语：bursting at the seams（爆满）高频；coal seam（煤层）；seamless adj. 无缝的（seamless transition 无缝衔接）。
collocations: burst at the seams 爆满
words.mnemonic: sew 缝出的线痕 → 接缝

words.definition: n. 部门，行业；领域；（军事）防区

examples.en: The service sector accounts for most jobs in the city.
examples.zh: 服务业提供了城里大部分就业岗位。

examples.en: The private sector is investing heavily in education.
examples.zh: 私营部门正在大力投资教育。

words.usage: public/private sector（公共/私营部门）、the financial sector（金融业）商经高频；sect（切）→ 划出的区域；比 section 更偏产业划分。
words.mnemonic: sect(切)+or → 切分出的板块 → 部门

words.definition: n. 仔细审查，监视

examples.en: The deal is coming under close scrutiny from regulators.
examples.zh: 这笔交易正受到监管机构的严格审查。

examples.en: Her every move was subjected to public scrutiny.
examples.zh: 她的一举一动都受到公众审视。

words.usage: under close/public scrutiny（处于密切审查之下）高频；subject to scrutiny（接受审查）；scrutinize v. 细看；scrutiny 源拉丁「检视衣物的破洞」。

confusables.note: scrum 橄榄球争球，scr- 同头

words.mnemonic: scrut(查)+iny → 细查 → 审查

words.definition: adj. 偶尔的，不经常的

examples.en: Apart from occasional trips to town, he rarely leaves the farm.
examples.zh: 除了偶尔进城，他很少离开农场。

examples.en: There was occasional laughter from the next room.
examples.zh: 隔壁房间不时传来笑声。

words.usage: occasional visitor/rain/outburst（偶尔来访/降雨/发作）；occasionally adv. 偶尔；occasional table（边桌，临时用桌）。与 random（随机的）之别。
collocations: an occasional drink 偶尔小酌
words.mnemonic: occasion（场合）偶尔出现 → 偶尔的

words.definition: n. （乡间）小路；车道；跑道

examples.en: The house is down a narrow country lane.
examples.zh: 房子位于一条狭窄的乡间小路尽头。

examples.en: The bus is in the inside lane.
examples.zh: 公共汽车在内侧车道。

words.usage: a narrow lane（窄巷）；bus/cycling lane（公交/自行车道）交通高频；memory lane（怀旧之旅：down memory lane）；fast lane 快车道→快节奏生活。
collocations: down memory lane 怀旧之行
words.mnemonic: 两田埂夹一线 → 小路；车道
